title: Verify current network behavior against the pre-merge feature baseline
summary: Verify that current HEAD preserves the network behavior evidenced at premerge anchor 90939012; Phase 1 through Phase 8 architecture work is explicitly deferred and is not part of this recovery plan.

in: RV64 and LA64 Git, DNS, HTTP, and HTTPS witnesses
RV64 and LA64 musl/glibc netperf and iperf groups
the fixed RV64 musl LTP socket split and verdict-set comparison

steps.title: Verify current HEAD against the fixed pre-merge network acceptance baseline
verification: Follow docs/progress/research/2026-07-31-premerge-network-recovery-test-matrix.md exactly.
Run the targeted host IRQ, reactor, socket fdtable, TCP lifecycle, external connect, veth, and network tick tests.
Require RV64 Git/DNS/HTTP/HTTPS plus NET_IRQ 9/9 and LA64 Git/DNS/HTTP/HTTPS 8/8.
Require RV64 and LA64 netperf/iperf musl/glibc groups to remain 22/22 per architecture; use direct anchor replay only as supplementary failure classification, not to erase an earlier passing witness.
Run current filtered libc-test network ABI groups; do not use retired libctest-network or lmbench-network selectors.

Compare all six RV64 musl LTP socket split verdict sets against the historical ledger; when an aggregate is not reproducible, replay the complete same-command batch from 90939012 and record any conflict with an older focused pass.
steps.notes: The ordered run and follow-up review completed on 2026-07-31, but recovery is blocked. OSComp rootfs compatibility and the musl libc-test launcher were restored. Zero-length UDP delivery is a Linux-compatibility repair required by the current netperf path, not source restoration from 90939012. RV64 Gate C is 22/22. LA64 is 20/22 with two TCP_CRR Zone assertions, while ancestor 87ae1d21 has a recorded 22/22 witness; one 90939012 ENOMEM replay does not supersede that pass. LTP b3/b4 current/anchor verdict sets match, but b6 current setsockopt06 stalls despite a historical focused 1/1 and lacks a complete anchor-tail comparison. Phase 1 through Phase 8 remain deferred, so the blockers are recorded rather than silently expanded.

steps.title: Retain closing TCP transports independently of fd lifetime
verification: Default close sends queued data before FIN.
SO_LINGER(on,0) produces a real RST path without the current application-data flush loop.

Registry capacity, fairness, namespace release, and full-capacity behavior have tests.

verification: FIN_WAIT, TIME_WAIT, RST-send, and deadline paths terminate predictably.

verification.notes: b1, b2, and b5 retained the supported historical result; b3 and b4 matched direct 90939012 verdict sets. Current and one anchor replay both stalled in setsockopt06, but the historical focused ledger records setsockopt06 1/1 and the anchor tail was not replayed. The repository-wide unit gate is not green: three unrelated tx-shims tests fail reproducibly (signal rt_sigaction mask, execve argv overflow, and AF_UNIX socketpair blocking write), and the tx-ext4 test target has eight stale BackendPageRequest::with_target call sites. None is in the touched network recovery path, so they are recorded rather than expanded into this task.

The repository-wide validator stops on the pre-existing docs/progress/plans/2026-07-24-network-time-integration.json use of step status `completed`; jq parsing and direct field/status/path review of this new record passed.

risks: Treating historical pre-merge benchmark scores as current evidence would produce a false recovery claim.
Using retired libctest-network or lmbench-network selectors can silently run default groups and create false evidence.
Using a damaged shared RV64 OSComp image can misclassify ext4 failures as network regressions.
Comparing only aggregate LTP scores can hide a changed TFAIL, TBROK, TCONF, or TWARN set.
A functional Git pass without the IRQ counter sentinel does not prove the restored RV64 NET_IRQ mechanism ran.
A direct anchor failure can be environment- or capacity-sensitive and must not erase a separate earlier passing witness.
LA64 TCP_CRR currently fails through a kernel Zone assertion despite the recorded 87ae1d21 LA64 22/22 run; resolving that capacity/object-lifetime path overlaps deferred Phase 7.
LTP setsockopt06 currently stalls while the historical focused ledger records 1/1; one equally stalled anchor replay is insufficient to declare parity.

UDP payload readiness still derives from payload_recv_bytes while empty-datagram presence is represented by can_recv; direct zero-length receive and netperf termination pass, but full readiness convergence remains deferred with Phase 6/7.
blockers: LA64 netperf musl and glibc TCP_CRR must return to the recorded 87ae1d21 5/5 behavior; the current Zone post-barrier enqueue assertion overlaps deferred Phase 7 capacity/object lifecycle work and requires user authorization before expansion.

Gate E b6 is unresolved: current setsockopt06 stalls while the historical focused witness records 1/1; rerun the full matching anchor batch and diagnose only if the user keeps this case in recovery scope.
